description:
The release zip: published to Maven Central as this module's zip
    artifact by the release profile (doc/specs/maven-central-publishing.md). `mvn package`
    assembles target/logaperture-1.0.0-beta.1.zip containing the agent
    jar, the logctl CLI (jar + launchers), a WildFly install doc, and the
    licence, for someone to try LogAperture in a PRE-PRODUCTION WildFly.
    See doc/specs/distribution-bundle.md.

    Depends on logaperture-agent and logaperture-cli for reactor build
    ordering only (so their shaded jars exist before this module runs); the
    assembly copies those jars in by path, not as dependencies — see
    src/assembly/dist.xml.
